name: Taelan's Tower
summary: This fortified guard tower stands vigilant along the southern road leading into Hearthglen. Currently occupied by Scarlet Crusade sentries, it serves as a critical checkpoint guarding the approaches to the crusade's northern bastion.

sections.title: Scarlet Outpost
sections.body: Positioned strategic along the mountain path leading up to Hearthglen, this stone watchtower is manned by disciplined Scarlet Crusade guards. From the parapets, crusader lookouts survey the blighted vales of the Western Plaguelands, ensuring no Scourge fiends—or unwelcome travelers—approach Lord Fordring's stronghold unchecked. At the top of the tower rests a holy coffer guarded by the zealous garrison.

sections.title: A Father's Grief
sections.body: This remote tower becomes the tragic staging ground for the culmination of Tirion Fordring's efforts to redeem his son, Highlord Taelan Fordring. After breaking free from the Scarlet Crusade's indoctrination, Taelan fights his way down the road from Mardenholde Keep only to be cornered here by Grand Inquisitor Isillien and struck down. Though Tirion arrives in time to avenge his son and slay the grand inquisitor, Taelan draws his final breath at the tower's base, prompting the elder paladin to reclaim his righteous crusade against evil.

faq.answer: The tower is held by the Scarlet Crusade. Zealous guards and spellbinders patrol its levels and the surrounding road to intercept any intruders trying to reach Hearthglen.

It marks the endpoint of the dramatic escape during the quest 'In Dreams'. Here, Highlord Taelan Fordring is ambushed and killed by Grand Inquisitor Isillien, and Tirion Fordring arrives to slay Isillien and mourn his fallen son.

faq.q: What is inside the holy coffer atop the tower?
faq.answer: A holy coffer rests at the tower's summit, containing the Mark of the Lightbringer, a sacred relic guarded by Scarlet Crusade defenders.
The tower stands directly beside the main road leading into Hearthglen, nestled in the mountains of the northern Western Plaguelands.

angles.text: For paladins, this tower is consecrated by blood and tragic loss; it is the site where Tirion Fordring took up his holy purpose once more after witnessing his son's martyrdom.
